entities.summary: Reem Frainah, a Palestinian human rights activist, has been a leading voice in the global fight for women's and children's rights. As executive director of the Aisha Association for Woman and Child Protection, she has worked tirelessly to empower marginalized communities and promote social justice. Born into a family of Palestinian refugees, Reem's experiences of displacement and trauma have deeply informed her advocacy work. Her efforts have been recognized internationally, including being named a Goodwill Ambassador for the United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees. Reem's work has also been featured in prominent media outlets, including The New York Times and Al Jazeera. Through her work, Reem has helped to raise awareness about the plight of Palestinian refugees and has advocated for policies that promote their rights and dignity. She continues to be a powerful voice for social justice, inspiring a new generation of activists and advocates. Despite the many challenges she has faced, Reem remains committed to her work, using her platform to amplify the voices of those who are often overlooked or marginalized.
